"""A fixture module for the docrules banned-word test."""

# this comment holds the banned word plethora, on purpose
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    """Say hello.

    The word plethora above lives in a comment, not here, so the docstring
    below stays clean: it says hello and nothing else.

    Args:
        name: The name to greet.

    Returns:
        A greeting.
    """
    return f"hello {name}"
